nodes.label: Logout only via POST with CSRF
nodes.norm_label: logout only via post with csrf
nodes.rationale: Foreign pages cannot log users out with a link or .

nodes.label: Steps checklist with localStorage progress
nodes.rationale: Step completion state kept locally per recipe slug in browser localStorage; no server state.

nodes.label: Recipe approval queue (/admin/kolejka)
nodes.rationale: Content from editors is only publicly visible after admin acceptance; rejection carries a reason visible to the editor, who can fix and resubmit.

nodes.label: Administrator role
nodes.rationale: Full rights; recipes added/approved by admin are public immediately.

nodes.label: Redaktor (editor) role
nodes.rationale: Editors create/edit own recipes, but all new content goes through the approval queue; no self-registration, accounts created by admin.

nodes.label: XSS protection: autoescape + CSP nonce, no inline handlers
nodes.norm_label: xss protection: autoescape + csp nonce, no inline handlers
nodes.rationale: script-src 'self' 'nonce-...' without unsafe-inline so injected scripts cannot run even if autoescaping fails; behaviour moved to static/js/app.js via data-confirm/data-toggle-target attributes.

nodes.norm_label: young chef in white double-breasted jacket

nodes.label: Red-Tinted Hand-Drawn Line-Art Style, Circular Crop
nodes.norm_label: red-tinted hand-drawn line-art style, circular crop

nodes.label: Recipe App Logo (Chef Illustration)
nodes.rationale: Circular-cropped illustrated logo establishing the recipe app's brand identity around home/professional cooking; warm red/sepia monochrome line-art style gives a hand-drawn, approachable feel.

nodes.label: Large Steel Mixing Bowl with Red Sauce Being Whisked
nodes.norm_label: large steel mixing bowl with red sauce being whisked

nodes.label: Environment variables (.env, APP_ENV, SECRET_KEY...)
nodes.rationale: Defaults to production mode which refuses to start without a valid SECRET_KEY.

nodes.label: ZIP backup export/import (merge / skip_existing / wipe)
nodes.rationale: Portable recipes.json + images/ format independent of DB engine; orphaned images after wipe are a deliberate simplification.

nodes.label: Cron backups via flask export-backup
nodes.rationale: Backups should be kept off-server; CLI works without browser session and writes file with 600 permissions.

nodes.label: Alembic/Flask-Migrate schema migrations
nodes.rationale: Schema created via flask db upgrade instead of db.create_all() so schema evolution is versioned.

nodes.label: Uploaded image sanitization via Pillow re-encode
nodes.norm_label: uploaded image sanitization via pillow re-encode
nodes.rationale: Re-encoding rather than trusting extension/MIME rejects polyglots, strips EXIF/GPS and trailing data, guards decompression bombs, and stores under random UUID names.

nodes.label: Login rate limiting and account lockout
nodes.norm_label: login rate limiting and account lockout
nodes.rationale: Two layers: per-IP Flask-Limiter and per-account lockout; lockout is a conscious trade-off (DoS by known username) mitigated by flask unlock-user.

nodes.label: PROXY_COUNT trusted reverse proxy headers
nodes.rationale: X-Forwarded-* headers are ignored unless proxies configured, preventing IP spoofing to bypass per-IP rate limits.

nodes.label: Safe post-login redirects (?next=)
nodes.rationale: Prevents login link being used for phishing open redirects.

nodes.label: SQL injection protection via SQLAlchemy ORM
nodes.norm_label: sql injection protection via sqlalchemy orm

nodes.label: Timing-attack / username enumeration protection
nodes.rationale: Dummy password hash check and identical error message so response time and text do not reveal account existence.

nodes.label: Ingredient sections
nodes.rationale: Lets ingredient lists be grouped under named headings (e.g. dough, cream); scaling covers all sections; stored in backup as ingredients_sections.
